headline: Zoning changes for multi-family dwellings and a Gloucester Crossing modification; a data center prohibition and zoning definitions are postponed to January.
summary: The agenda carries over a zoning amendment on dimensional rules for multi-family dwellings and their accessory uses. Two other zoning items are continued to January 6, 2027.
items: Dimensional rules for multi-family dwellings and accessory uses (Section 3.2.2, other than signs)
Planning Director memo on Gloucester Crossing determination of insubstantial modification
Zoning Ordinance definitions amendment (Section VI), from the Zoning Board of Appeals
Adding data center to uses prohibited in all districts (Section 2.3.8)
location: City Hall – 1st Floor Conference Room, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester MA 01930
